caption: The video captures a wide beach at sunset, with a largely stable view of the horizon, clouds, and surf. The sky holds streaked orange, yellow, and teal clouds above a low sun glow near the sea line. A long breaking wave crosses the mid-distance, its white crest continually reshaping as it moves toward the shore. A thinner foam line near the wet sand also shifts, changing shape and position in small steps. The broad foreground sand reflects the sky in gold on the left and turquoise on the right. Tiny ripples disturb the mirrored colors, softening their edges as water moves across the surface. The sun, cloud shapes, and horizon remain visually steady during the scene. The camera shows no obvious pan or zoom, so the visible motion belongs to the waves and their reflections. The surf is still changing, with no clear start or finish to the wave cycle.
relations: The mid-distance breaking wave continually reshapes its white crest as it advances toward the shore.
The thin foam line near the wet sand shifts its shape and position in small, continuous steps.
Tiny ripples on the foreground sand disturb the mirrored sky colors, softening their edges as water moves.
The sun, cloud shapes, and horizon remain visually steady while the surf and reflections change continuously.
